settings.heading: How does the Verra Rituel™ Antifungal Soap work?
settings.row_content: Verra Rituel combines three clinically studied natural ingredients. Tea Tree Oil kills fungus by disrupting fungal cell membranes. Eucalyptus Oil provides deep antiseptic cleansing. Activated Charcoal draws out toxins and neutralizes odor. Just lather, let it sit for 60 seconds, and rinse — your skin does the rest.

settings.heading: How long will it take to see results?
settings.row_content: Most people notice visible improvement within the first 1–2 weeks. Itching and odor typically reduce within days. Full clearance builds over 30 days of daily use. Every case is different — mild infections clear faster, stubborn ones may take the full month. Consistency is key.

settings.heading: What types of fungal infections does it treat?
settings.row_content: Verra Rituel is effective against athlete's foot, jock itch, ringworm, toenail fungus symptoms, and general body fungus. The tea tree oil formula works on multiple fungal strains. For severe or persistent infections, we recommend pairing with advice from your healthcare provider.

settings.heading: Is it safe for sensitive skin?
settings.row_content: Yes. Verra Rituel is hypoallergenic, paraben-free, and sulfate-free. It's made with natural ingredients and is gentle enough for daily use on all skin types, including sensitive skin. If you have a known allergy to tea tree oil, consult your doctor first.

settings.heading: Can I use it on my whole body?
settings.row_content: Absolutely. While it's especially effective on feet, groin, and body areas prone to fungal growth, Verra Rituel is safe to use as a full-body soap. Many customers use it as their daily shower bar for overall skin health and odor prevention.

settings.heading: Do you offer a guarantee?
settings.row_content: Yes! Every order is backed by our 30-day money-back guarantee. If you don't see visible improvement — less fungus, less odor, healthier skin — just reach out and we'll refund you in full. No hassle, no questions.
